title: Developers as Creatives

reader_summary.headline: Hi, everyone, welcome to the A6&Z podcast.
reader_summary.overview: Hi, everyone, welcome to the A6&Z podcast. I'm Sonal, and we're here with our first new episode recorded this year, and it's with Jeff Lawson. He's the author of the new book just out today called Ask Your Developer.

key_points.text: I'm Sonal, and we're here with our first new episode recorded this year, and it's with Jeff Lawson.
key_points.evidence_quote: I'm Sonal, and we're here with our first new episode recorded this year, and it's with Jeff Lawson, the CEO and co-founder of Cloud Communications Platform as a Service Company, Twilio.

key_points.evidence_quote: He's the author of the new book just out today called Ask Your Developer, How to Harness the Power of Software Developers and Win in the 21st Century.

key_points.text: It's super relevant, obviously, since developers play an outsized role in high-performing tech companies, but are also actually critical in all companies.
key_points.evidence_quote: It's super relevant, obviously, since developers play an outsized role in high-performing tech companies, but are also actually critical in all companies, given software has eaten the world.

key_points.text: And as we've seen with the pandemic, education and health care, and pretty much every organization is now reliant on tech.
key_points.evidence_quote: And as we've seen with the pandemic, education and health care, and pretty much every organization is now reliant on tech.

thesis: The discussion argues that software has evolved into a new supply chain where companies must build their customer-facing interfaces to achieve differentiation, as buying off-the-shelf solutions no longer suffices in a competitive market. It further posits that the choice between building and buying has shifted from a strategic trade-off to a binary decision of building versus dying, driven by the necessity for organizations to listen to customers and innovate faster than incumbents.
